result:
Perfect! All tests now pass. 

**The bug was:** In `tally/invoice.py:42`, the discount condition used `>` instead of `>=`. This meant the bulk discount (5% off) only applied when units exceeded 10, but it should apply when units reached 10 or more.

**The fix:** Changed `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` to `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:` so the bulk discount correctly starts at 10 units, as the test name indicates.
